<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt"><b>Item&#8201;7.01</b></span> <span style="font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;Regulation FD Disclosure.</b></span></p>


<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In connection with the pending separation of ADI
Global Distribution Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) from Resideo Technologies, Inc., the Company is holding its previously announced
investor day event on July 14, 2026 (the &#8220;investor day event&#8221;). In connection with the investor day event, the Company issued
a press release on July 14, 2026, a copy of which is furnished herewith as Exhibit 99.1 A copy of the investor presentation to be used
in connection with the investor day event is furnished herewith as Exhibit 99.2 and will be available on the investor relations section
of the Company&#8217;s website.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The information furnished under this Item 7.01,
including Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, shall not be deemed &#8220;filed&#8221; for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of
1934, as amended (the &#8220;Exchange Act&#8221;), or incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended,
or the Exchange Act, except as shall be expressly set forth by specific reference in such a filing.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt"><b>Item&#8201;9.01.</b></span> <span style="font-size: 10pt"><b>Financial Statements and Exhibits. </b></span></p>


<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>
